reason: A Web UI plugin that displays the standard reconnecting banner when an established Host connection becomes unavailable and removes it after reconnection, without polling or replacing the shell.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中，当已连接的 Host 不可用时显示标准重连横幅，并在恢复连接后自动隐藏。
summaries.en: Displays the standard reconnecting banner in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI when an established Host becomes unavailable and hides it after reconnection.

capabilities: Displays a reconnecting banner in the Web UI after a previously connected Host becomes unavailable
Uses the public connection.hostDescription source and shell.overlay UI slot
Automatically hides the banner when the Host reconnects
